messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — executive dry-run for Acme renewal is 09:00 PT tomorrow. Want a focused 20m walkthrough of the slides + 10m Q&A. Main goals: align on renewal ask, surface any onboarding blockers, and confirm exec speakers.

Jason Li: Sounds good. Can we lock the top 2 KPIs we show? Adoption MAU and latency SLO compliance.

Tina Alvarez: Agreed on MAU + SLOs. Also want a one-slide summary of onboarding milestones — customers keep asking about single-sign-on and custom prompt templates.

Sophie Granger: I'll polish slide 3 (health dashboard) — will add the onboarding milestone lane and a short risks row.

Maya Chen: @Sophie thanks. Jason — can you prepare the KPI numbers (last 90d trend + YoY) and a 1-liner on what we recommend the exec ask be (discount vs committed capacity)?

Jason Li: I'll drop the numbers into slide 2 by EOD. Recommendation draft: 12-month committed Dedicated pool with 10% discount + 2 dedicated onboarding sessions.

Narayan Patel: Heads-up on renewal risk: usage looks healthy but we have 2 active tickets about model config drift. Marking Moderate risk until config fixes are shipped. ETA for fix is next Wed.

Tina Alvarez: Noted. I'll include a short mitigation plan (temp rollback to pinned model + scheduled evals) on the risk slide.

Maya Chen: Action items recap:
- Sophie: update health dashboard slide + onboarding milestone lane (owner: Sophie, due: tonight)
- Jason: KPI numbers + exec-ask draft (owner: Jason, due: EOD)
- Tina: mitigation plan phrasing + enablement schedule (owner: Tina, due: EOD)
- Narayan: short status blurb on model drift + ETA for fix (owner: Narayan, due: tomorrow morning)
- Maya: finalize speaker order + 1-slide script for exec ask (owner: Maya, due: tonight)

Sophie Granger: Copy. Will also add two bullets for enablement: "customer workshops" and "playbook handoff".

CS Bot: Reminder: Dry-run scheduled — Acme Exec Dry-run · 09:00 PT · 30m — calendar invite sent to participants.

Maya Chen: One more thing — can we surface customer feedback highlight (quote) on slide 4? Short, meaningful quote about latency improvements from pilot. Anyone got a recent one?

Jason Li: Pulled from last week's NPS notes: "Latency reduced deployment risk and cut support load in half" — think that works as a short testimonial.

Tina Alvarez: That works. I'll slot it into slide 4.

Maya Chen: Great. If no blockers we'll meet at 09:00 PT — dry-run will be run like the exec meeting (strict 20m for presentation). :thumbsup:

Narayan Patel: No blockers from infra. Will ping if the fix ETA slips.

Sophie Granger: Done with dashboard edits, pushed to the shared deck: https://drive.redwood.ai/Acme/exec-dryrun-deck (comment with final slide numbers).

Maya Chen: Perfect — thanks everyone. See you tomorrow.
